text:
maya: starting nyc3 bring-up for an 8x A100 pool. doing a short sanity smoke + handoff at 12:30 UTC, want to run a condensed checklist first. anyone available?

todd: i'm free, can join. what's the scope of the smoke?

maya: focus on boot, driver stack, network routes, gpu health, and a quick inference sample under load. keep it ~20 minutes.

raj: i'll validate node provisioning and PV mounts. will check kubelet/drivers.

infra-bot: Provision job #p-3745 started for nyc3-gpu-pool. ETA 7m. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/p-3745

sophie: i'll run the cost/capacity sanity — ensure assigned quota matches reserved capacity and review burst policy.

oncall: oncall here, can monitor SLO dashboards during the test.

maya: ok checklist I'm proposing (condensed):
- node bootstrap: kernel + nvidia driver match 
- nvidia-smi shows 8 gpus, no MIG partitions
- kube nodes Ready, no CrashLoopBackOff
- mount /mnt/models PV test write/read
- network egress to object store <50ms median
- small load test: 10 concurrent requests, 1024 tokens, measure p95 latency
- traceroute to control plane region endpoints
- NVMe health and disk pressure <70%
- time sync (ntp) drift <2s
- alert rules firing? none expected

todd: small tweak — add driver module checks: `modinfo nvidia` + `nvidia-container-cli --load-kmods`

maya: good call. add security check too: docker runtime user namespaces / seccomp present.

raj: running node checks now. patching kubelet config to set max-pods=110 on gpu nodes. will post results.

infra-bot: Node bootstrap logs: node-nyc3-01 connected, 12:18:23 UTC. kubelet v1.27.3, docker 24.0.2.

maya: run the inference smoke with the small client:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://nyc3.ingress.internal/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-a100-small","input":"summarize: short"}' | jq -r '.latency_ms'
```
Run it 10x concurrent. report p50/p95.

sophie: cost check: reserved commitment shows 8 GPUs @ commit tier B. expected monthly delta ~+$9k. burst allowed up to +2 GPUs on demand.

raj: node checks done: `nvidia-smi` shows 8 GPUs, temps idle 35-42C. no driver mismatch. PV mount rw test passed on node-nyc3-01. kube status: 5 nodes Ready, taints applied.

maya: cool. oncall, can you watch SLOs while I kick load?

oncall: watching. setting dashboard alert window to 5m. will call if p95 breaches 250ms.

maya: kicking load now. 10 concurrent, 5s interval.

infra-bot: Load test started by maya — 10 clients x 10 requests each.

maya: first pass results: p50=85ms, p95=170ms, error rate 0.8% (a few 502s).

oncall: saw transient 502s at 12:22:05, traced to ingress timeout 30s. retry recovered.

raj: checking pod logs — a short OOMKilled on model-cache pod, happened once. global cache config set to 32GB, maybe bump to 40GB for warm cache.

maya: noted. I'd prefer to keep memory conservative; set H2 to 36GB and re-run. also we should capture the failing request IDs for postmortem.

sophie: cost impact of bumping cache from 32->36GB is negligible on reserved tier, ok from finance POV.

maya: re-run small load with adjusted cache.

infra-bot: Model-cache redeploy complete, 12:24:30 UTC.

maya: second pass: p50=92ms, p95=190ms, error rate 0.0%. nvme iops stable.

oncall: dashboards look green. latency SLOs within 250ms p95. I'm comfortable with handoff if we document the OOM pattern.

raj: I've opened infra ticket INF-879 to track cache sizing and a follow-up capacity test at 80 clients.

maya: next steps for handoff doc:
- write concise runbook with the condensed checklist + links to logs and infra ticket
- include cost delta and burst policy (sophie)
- schedule full acceptance run next week at 03:00 UTC (raj)
- postmortem if any new regressions observed after 24h

sophie: will add the cost blurb to the runbook and confirm quota page links.

oncall: I'll accept the handoff once runbook is posted and 24h monitoring shows no new alerts.

maya: thanks all — will draft runbook now and link here when ready. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Runbook draft created at https://docs.redwood/runbooks/nyc3-quickbringup (draft) by maya

maya: draft posted. ping me for edits.

raj: +1 reviewed, added node selector note for future AZ-aware placement.

sophie: added cost appendix. ready for handoff once 24h clear.

oncall: acknowledged. moving to monitoring watch.

maya: closing thread for now, will reopen if issues crop up.
